description: Source file implementing MKLDNN tensor operations with conditional compilation based on MKLDNN support, including functions for view, reshape, clone, and transpose operations.

methods.name: mkldnn_view
methods.description: Creates a view of an MKLDNN tensor, not supported if MKLDNN is disabled.

methods.name: mkldnn_reshape
methods.description: Reshapes an MKLDNN tensor, with support for size inference.

methods.name: mkldnn_transpose
methods.description: Transposes an MKLDNN tensor along specified dimensions.

methods.name: mkldnn_transpose_
methods.description: In-place transpose of an MKLDNN tensor, not supported yet.
